exposure: Induction of labor for non-medical/social reasons
cohort: 198 women at a University NHS Foundation Trust: 74 requesting induction of labor for non-medical/social reasons and 124 undergoing routine induction for post-dates
finding: There is no increased risk of Caesarean section or other serious complications if women are induced for reasons thought to be not medically justified by medical professionals.
mod_finding: Women with a BMI of less than 30 are more likely to achieve a vaginal birth in the maternal request group when compared to the control group.
